coordinate_convention: original source pixels; x right, y down; no axial endpoint or material-point correspondence
annotation_method: Independent manual inspection of original images, with enlarged and brightness-adjusted copies used only as display aids. No model projection used to place points.
observability_limits: Repeated own-shaft silhouettes from a camera mounted on that instrument are correlated mount observations, not independent geometric views.
The long cylinder is reflective and defocused near the camera. Annotation uncertainty is conservative visual localization tolerance, not a statistical standard deviation.
Only observed tangent fragments should constrain the fit; do not extrapolate into vignette, across thread or the articulated/milled connector.
Shaft radius in the current CAD is a model assumption to verify for each actual tool; silhouette alignment does not independently establish physical radius.
The reserved frames check image agreement under changed background and lighting. They do not provide an independent camera-to-shaft pose because each camera moves rigidly with its own shaft.
No usable stereo shaft edge was identified. These observations alone cannot identify global phantom/tool height or all wrist-camera intrinsic and metric-mount parameters.

feature_semantics.shaft_cylinder_silhouette: Outer occluding tangent of the long cylinder; image_left/image_right designate observed side in the source image, not a material generator line.
feature_semantics.endpoints: Visibility-limited samples, with no 3D axial coordinate assignment.
feature_semantics.excluded: Circular shoulder, milled head/connector, articulated jaw, borescope housing, inner reflection, stitch thread, tissue crease and optical vignette.

correlation_groups.psm1: All own-shaft records share one camera mount and nearly the same underlying silhouette.
correlation_groups.psm2: All own-shaft records share one camera mount and nearly the same underlying silhouette.

review_notes: The broad pink fan below each articulated head is the actual polished shaft reflecting the pad, not transparent geometry or a tissue surface. Its narrow dark central streak is an interior reflection/connector continuation, not a long-shaft tangent.
PSM1 frame75/150 provide the strongest paired constraints. PSM1 frame300 supplies no reliable shaft boundary; frame525 has only a blurred left boundary.
PSM2 short tangents above y=356 are comparatively reproducible, but lower continuations are defocused. The frame4 left tangent is crossed by thread.
Apparent cylinder fan width constrains lens/mount geometry jointly with assumed shaft radius. It cannot alone prove a focal-length, camera-offset, or global table-height correction.
original_image_sources_note: Logical annotation sources; replay images are in images/.
